prompt: FIVE chronological game animation frames: Oda Nobunaga UNARMED two-hand downward diagonal swing. Image1 is the sole authority for exact face, black-red-gold armor, tall gold horn helmet, red gold-trimmed cape and REQUIRED black back banner with gold Oda flower and white 天下布武. Image2 supplies ONLY anatomy scale and low ready stance; its missing banner must NOT be copied. EVERY frame MUST visibly include black sashimono cloth and complete pole behind shoulder, no omissions. NO gun, sword, scabbard, stick or other weapon; both hands EMPTY clenched fists together in imaginary two-hand grip. 1 ready fists waist;2 overhead windup above rear shoulder;3 step RIGHT, rotate hips and swing fists diagonally DOWN across chest;4 deep front lunge, fists finish LOW before right knee;5 recoil waist guard. All RIGHT-facing, both feet grounded, same anatomy/head/torso/limb size, genuine weight transfer. Full helmet, banner, cape, fists and boots contained in each frame. No effects/light/slash arcs/flames/shadow/UI/labels/numbers. Pure #FF00FF backdrop. Intermediate3columns x2rows ATLAS,5 figures row-major, bottom-right empty magenta. Square cells, generous gutters, NO grid lines. Body helmet-to-sole about80%cellheight, soles90%, do not shrink to fit gesture. Output to pack1280x256.
